## History

Dan Reese hurled insults at [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md), continuing his harsh behavior toward her. He later insulted both [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) to confront him. Walter agreed to a fight and ultimately defeated Dan after school the following evening.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. ## Relationships

### [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dan-reese--walter-blythe.md)

Dan Reese and [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) became schoolboy enemies after Dan hurled insults directed at [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) and Walter's mother, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Driven by a desire to defend them despite his personal dread of conflict, Walter confronted Dan and agreed to a fight after school. Walter ultimately defeated Dan in the brawl, establishing their hostile relationship.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P20](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), +10 more_
